title: The ‘witch-hunt’ of Jason Arday
english: Jason Arday, who became Cambridge University’s youngest Black professor, recently passed away following a brief period of intense public scrutiny. Before his death, he faced and consistently denied allegations of plagiarism that sparked a major media controversy. A vigil was held in London to honor his memory and legacy.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ትንሹ ጥቁር ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩት ጄሰን አርዳይ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። ከሕልፈታቸው በፊት በፕላጂያሪዝም ወይም በሌላ ሰው ሥራ ስርቆት ወንጀል ተከሰው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ክሱ መሰረተ ቢስ መሆኑን ሲገልጹ ቆይተዋል። በለንደን ለክብራቸው የተደረገ መታሰቢያ ሥነ-ሥርዓት ተካሂዷል።
oromo: Pirofesara guddicha Yuunivarsitii Kaambirij kan ta'an Jeeson Arday erga gabaabaa booda du'aan addunyaa kanarraa darbaniiru. Du'a isaanii dura, yakka hatattamaa (plagiarism) irratti himatamanii turan, ta'us himata kana guutummaatti haalanii turan. Magaalaa Landanitti yaadannoon isaaniif taasifameera.

title: US judge says government can revoke deportation protections for Ethiopians
english: A U.S. federal judge has ruled that the Trump administration is allowed to end Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for over 5,000 Ethiopian nationals. This decision follows a Supreme Court ruling that reduced the power of courts to challenge the government's authority to cancel these deportation protections. As a result, the administration can now move forward with plans to remove TPS protections for citizens from Ethiopia and several other countries.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከ5,000 በላይ ለሚሆኑ ኢትዮጵያውያን ተሰጥቶ የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ የጥበቃ ሁኔታ (TPS) እንዲሰርዝ መፍቀዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የወጣው ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱ መንግስት እነዚህን የጥበቃ መብቶች የመሰረዝ ስልጣኑን እንዲገድቡ ፍርድ ቤቶች ያላቸውን አቅም ከቀነሰ በኋላ ነው። በውሳኔው መሰረት፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢትዮጵያ እና ከሌሎች በርካታ ሀገራት ለመጡ ስደተኞች ሲሰጥ የነበረውን የጥበቃ መብት ሙሉ በሙሉ የመሰረዝ ሂደቱን መቀጠል ይችላል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa Ameerikaa tokko mootummaan Trump lammiilee Itoophiyaa 5,000 ol ta'aniif eeyyama yeroo turtiif kenname (TPS) akka haqu murteesseera. Murtiin kun kan dhufe Mana Murtii Waliigalaa Ameerikaa eeyyama kana haquuf aangoo mootummaan qabu irratti gita gaaffii kaasuun akka hin danda'amne erga murteesseen booda. Bu'aa kana hordofuudhaan, mootummaan Ameerikaa lammiilee Itoophiyaa fi biyyoota biroo kanneen TPS qaban irratti tarkaanfii gaggeessuu ni danda'a.

title: US envoy calls out Israeli settler 'terrorism' in interview
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has publicly labeled the actions of Israeli settlers in the West Bank as terrorism. During an interview, he explained that their efforts to intimidate local populations and force behavioral changes meet the dictionary definition of the term. This statement follows his recent condemnation of a specific settler siege that targeted residents in the village of Qusra.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር በእስራኤል ማይክ ሀካቢ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎችን ድርጊት አሸባሪነት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። በአንድ ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ ሰፈራ ሰሪዎቹ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ፍርሃትን በመፍጠር ባህሪያቸውን ለመቀየር የሚወስዱት እርምጃ የአሸባሪነትን ትርጉም የሚያሟላ ነው። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው በኩስራ መንደር ላይ የተፈጸመውን የሰፈራ ሰሪዎች ከበባ ካወገዙ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Israa'elitti argaman Maayik Hakabii, gochaa qubattoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti raawwatan 'shororkeessummaa' jechuun ibsan. Hagabii gaaffii fi deebii taasisaniin, qubattoonni kun ummata sodaachisuun akkaataa jireenya isaanii jijjiiruuf yaaluun isaanii hiika shororkeessummaa kan guutu ta'uu ibsan. Ibsi kun kan kenname, qubattoonni baadiyaa Qusraa keessatti manneen jiraattotaa marfanii turan erga balaaleeffatanii boodadha.

title: Trump envoy 'deeply concerned' by Israeli strikes on Syrian air base
english: US special envoy for Syria, Tom Barrack, has criticized recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian military base, labeling them an unnecessary escalation that threatens regional stability. While Israel has not officially claimed responsibility, Barrack blamed the country for the attack following discussions with Syrian officials. The Syrian government condemned the strikes, arguing that Israel's actions are driven by expansionist motives rather than genuine security concerns.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሶሪያ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ቶም ባራክ በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በመቃወም፣ ድርጊቱ ለቀጠናው መረጋጋት የማይጠቅም እና አላስፈላጊ ውጥረት የሚፈጥር ነው ብለዋል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን በይፋ ባታምንም፣ የአሜሪካው መልዕክተኛ ከሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ ጥቃቱ በእስራኤል የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የሶሪያ መንግስት ጥቃቱን ያወገዘ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል እንቅስቃሴ ከጸጥታ ስጋት ይልቅ መስፋፋትን ያለመ እንደሆነ ተናግሯል።
oromo: Ergamtuun addaa Ameerikaa kan Siiriyaa, Tom Barrack, haleellaa qilleensa irraa Israa'el buufata waraanaa Siiriyaa irratti raawwatte balaaleffataniiru. Haleellaan kun tasgabbii naannichaa kan boorreesse fi barbaachisaa kan hin taane akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Israa'el haleellaa kana raawwachuu ishee ifatti kan hin mirkaneessine ta'us, hoggantoonni Siiriyaa waliin erga mari'atanii booda itti gaafatamummaan kan Israa'el ta'uu eeraniiru. Mootummaan Siiriyaa haleellaa kana kan balaaleffate yoo ta'u, gochi Israa'el kun sodaa nageenyaa irra darbee fedhii lafa babal'ifachuu irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu ibseera.

title: ICC says US sanctions 'undermine the rule of law'
english: The International Criminal Court has criticized the United States for imposing sanctions on its senior officials, stating that such actions threaten the global legal system. The court argues that targeting judicial figures for performing their duties weakens the rule of law. Despite this pressure, the ICC affirmed that it remains committed to its mission and continues to support its staff.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በከፍተኛ ባለስልጣኖቹ ላይ የአሜሪካ መንግስት የጣለውን ማዕቀብ ተችቷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህ እርምጃ አለም አቀፍ የህግ ስርዓትን የሚፈታተን መሆኑን ገልጿል። ዳኞች ስራቸውን በመስራታቸው ምክንያት ሲፈራረጁ ህግ የማስከበር ሂደቱ አደጋ ላይ እንደሚወድቅ የገለጸው ፍርድ ቤቱ፣ በስራው እንደሚቀጥልም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakkaa Addunyaa (ICC) mootummaan Ameerikaa hoggantoota isaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhate balaaleffateera. Tarkaanfiin kun sirna seeraa addunyaa miidhuu danda'a jedheera. Abbootii seeraa hojii isaanii raawwataniif sodaachisuun seera kabachiisuu irratti dhiibbaa akka qabu ibsuun, manni murtichaa hojii isaa daran cimsee itti fufuuf murteesseera.

title: Houthi ballistic missile hits house near Yemen’s Taiz
english: A Houthi-fired ballistic missile struck a residential home in the village of al-Akmah, located in Yemen's Maqbanah district. The explosion resulted in significant property damage and the death of several animals owned by the family. Fortunately, no people were harmed in the incident.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ታኢዝ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው አል-አክማ መንደር ላይ ባደረሱት የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት አንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ተመታ። ጥቃቱ በቤቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን በርካታ የቤት እንስሳት እንዲሞቱ አድርጓል። ሆኖም በሰዎች ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም።
oromo: Miseensota garee Huutii kanneen Yaman, naannoo Ta’izitti bakka al-Akmah jedhamutti roobsaniin boombiin balistii mana jireenya tokko rukutee jira. Miidhaan qabeenyaa guddaan mana sana irra ga’eera, akkasumas horiin garaa garaa du’aniiru. Haata’u malee, balaa kanaan namni tokkollee du’e ykn miidhame hin jiru.

title: US mulls shrinking military footprint in Gulf as a result of war on Iran: Report
english: The US government is considering reducing its military presence in the Gulf region due to the ongoing conflict with Iran. Defense officials are concerned about the vulnerability of existing bases to Iranian drone and missile strikes. Consequently, the Pentagon is evaluating whether to relocate these forces to more secure locations to better protect military assets.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ ያለውን ወታደራዊ መገኘት ለመቀነስ እያሰበ ነው። የመከላከያ ባለስልጣናት ነባር የአሜሪካ የጦር ሰፈሮች ለኢራን የድሮን እና የሮኬት ጥቃቶች ተጋላጭ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ መሰረት የፔንታጎን ሰራዊቱን ይበልጥ ደህንነታቸው በተጠበቁ አካባቢዎች ለማዘዋወር እያጤነ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa walitti bu’iinsa biyyattii fi Iraan gidduutti uumameen walqabatee, naannoo Gulf jedhamutti humna waraanaa ishee hir’isuuf karoora qabachaa jirti. Hojjettoonni ittisa biyyaa buufataalee waraanaa ammaa kun xiyyara malee balaliitotaa fi madooyyii Iraaniin rukutamuuf saaxilamoo ta’uu isaanii yaadda’u. Kanaafuu, Pentagon-ni meeshaalee waraanaa fi loltoota isaa bakka tasgabbaa’aa ta’etti jijjiiruuf mari’achaa jira.

title: Landmark trial on Meta’s impact on children’s mental health begins in US
english: A major legal trial has begun in the United States where 29 states are accusing Meta of designing Facebook and Instagram to intentionally addict young users and negatively impact their mental health. The states claim the company prioritizes profit by keeping children engaged while illegally gathering data from minors. Meta has denied these accusations, arguing that they have implemented effective safety measures and that the claims made by the attorneys general are unsupported.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የ29 ግዛቶች ጥምረት ሜታ በፌስቡክ እና ኢንስታግራም አፕሊኬሽኖች አማካኝነት የወጣቶችን የአእምሮ ጤና እንደጎዳ በመክሰስ የፍርድ ሂደት ጀምሯል። ግዛቶቹ ሜታ ትርፍ ለማግኘት ሲል ታዳጊዎችን ሱስ ውስጥ እንዲገቡ ማድረጉንና ህገ-ወጥ መረጃዎችን መሰብሰቡን ይከሳሉ። ሜታ በበኩሉ ክሱ መሠረተ ቢስ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ኩባንያው ለወጣቶች ደህንነት ሲባል የተለያዩ ጥበቃዎችን ተግባራዊ ማድረጉን ይከራከራል።
oromo: Mootummoonni 29 gara US-tti dhaabbata Meta irratti himata bananii jiru; himatichi Meta 'Facebook' fi 'Instagram' fayyadamuun fayyaa sammuu dargaggootaa miidhuu fi akka isaan harka keessa galan godhuudha. Himattonni akka jedhanitti, dhaabbatichi bu'aa qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuun ijoollee gahuufi ragaalee isaanii seeraan alatti akka walitti qabu himatu. Meta gamasaatiin, himanni kun dhugaa akka hin qabnee fi ijoolleen akka hin miidhamneef tarkaanfiileen eegumsaa gara garaa fudhatamuu isaa dubbata.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza City cafe kills six, including child
english: An Israeli military airstrike targeted a cafe in Gaza City, resulting in the deaths of six Palestinians, among them one child. Several other people sustained injuries during the attack, which witnesses say caused some victims to be thrown into the sea. While the strike caused civilian casualties, Israeli officials claimed they were aiming to hit four Hamas commanders.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ የአየር ጥቃት በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኝ ካፌ ላይ ተፈጽሞ አንድ ህጻንን ጨምሮ ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ በርካታ ሰዎችን የጎዳ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ ተጎጂዎች በፈንጂው ኃይል ወደ ባህር እንደተወረወሩ ተዘግቧል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው አራት የሃማስ አዛዦችን ለመምታት እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti kaafé tokko irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa raawwataniin, mucaa tokko dabalatee namoonni ja'a lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni biroon hedduun miidhaniiru; namoonni miidhamanis humna dhoohichaan gara galaanaatti darbatamuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa. Israa'el gama ishee, haleellaa kana kan raawwatte ajootoota Hamas afur irratti xiyyeeffachuun akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
english: A 4.8 magnitude earthquake struck near the historic city of Granada in southern Spain, causing minor injuries to three people and damaging buildings and vehicles. The tremor, which occurred on Tuesday morning, is part of a series of recent seismic activities in the region. Several public facilities, including the famous Alhambra palace, have temporarily closed as officials assess the damage.
amharic: የ4.8 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በደቡባዊ ስፔን ታሪካዊቷ ግራናዳ ከተማ አቅራቢያ ተከስቶ በሶስት ሰዎች ላይ ቀላል ጉዳት እንዲሁም በህንፃዎች እና በተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ማክሰኞ ጠዋት የተከሰተው ይህ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በአካባቢው በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ተከታታይነት ያላቸው ተመሳሳይ እንቅስቃሴዎች አካል ነው። ባለስልጣናት ጉዳቱን እየገመገሙ በመሆኑ የታዋቂው አልሃምብራ ቤተመንግስትን ጨምሮ በርካታ የህዝብ ተቋማት ለጊዜው ተዘግተዋል።
oromo: Sochiin lafaa hamma 4.8 qabu magaalaa seena-qabeettii Ispeen Granada biratti mudateen namoota sadii irratti miidhaan salphaan gahee, manneenii fi konkolaatonni miidhamaniiru. Roobii ganama kan mudate sochiin lafaa kun, guyyoota darban keessa naannichatti sochiileen lafaa walitti aansuun mudataa turan keessaa tokko. Bulchiistonni miidhaa qaqqabe qorachaa waan jiraniif, gamoon seena-qabeessi Alhambra dabalatee dhaabbileen ummataa muraasni yeroof cufamaniiru.

title: US mother begged for help before her children's killings, mother-in-law testifies
english: During the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children, family members testified that she was actively seeking medical help for her deteriorating mental health. While the prosecution argues the killings were intentional, the defense maintains that she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis at the time. Witnesses described Clancy as a loving mother who felt distressed and unlike herself in the months leading up to the tragedy.
amharic: ሶስት ልጆቿን በመግደል የተከሰሰችው ሊንዚ ክላንሲ፣ አሳዛኙ ድርጊት ከመፈጸሙ በፊት የአእምሮ ጤንነቷ እየተጎዳ እንደነበርና ለህክምና እርዳታ ትማጸን እንደነበር የቤተሰብ አባላት በችሎት መስክረዋል። አቃቤ ህግ ግድያው ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ሲከራከር፣ የመከላከያ ጠበቆች ግን እናትየው በወቅቱ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የወሊድ ጭንቀት (postpartum psychosis) ውስጥ እንደነበረች ይናገራሉ። ምስክሮችም ሊንዚ አፍቃሪ እናት እንደነበረችና ከወሊድ በኋላ በነበሩት ወራት ውስጥ በራሷ ላይ የነበረው ለውጥ ግራ እንዳጋባት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mucoolii ishee sadii ajjeesuun kan himatamte Lindsay Clancy, balaan kun osoo hin ta'in dura fayyaan ishee sammuu akka hir'ateef gargaarsa gaafachaa akka turte miseensonni maatii ishee mana murtii irratti dhugoomsaniiru. Abbaan alangaa ajjeechaan sun yaadamee kan raawwatame dha jedhee yoo falmu, gorsitoonni ittisaa garuu haati kun yeroo sana rakkoo sammuu kan da'umsa boodaa (postpartum psychosis) cimaa keessa akka turte dubbatu. Ragaaleen akka ibsanitti, Lindsay haadha jaalala qabdu turte, garuu erga da'ee booda rakkoo ishee mudateen of wallaaltee akka turte dubbataniiru.

title: Police attack Indonesian student protesters, arresting at least 21
english: Hundreds of university students gathered in Jakarta to demonstrate against government policies shortly after Indonesia's Independence Day celebrations. Security forces confronted the protesters, leading to violent clashes between the two groups. At least 21 students were taken into custody by police during the incident.
amharic: ኢንዶኔዢያ የነጻነት በዓሏን ካከበረች አንድ ቀን በኋላ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች በመንግስት ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ለመቃወም በጃካርታ አደባባይ ወጥተው ነበር። ተቃውሞው ወደ ግጭት በማምራቱ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች በወሰዱት እርምጃ ቢያንስ 21 ተማሪዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa bilisummaa Indoneeziya kabajee guyyaa tokko booda, barattoonni yunivarsitii dhibbaan lakkaa'aman siyaasa mootummaa mormuuf magaala Jakartatti hiriira ba'an. Hiririchi gara walitti bu'iinsaatti jijjiiramee, humnoonni nageenyaa namoota yoo xiqqaate 21 ta'an to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Barcelona seal deal for World Cup winner Rodri from Manchester City
english: FC Barcelona has officially signed Spanish star midfielder Rodri from Manchester City for 76.5 million euros. The 30-year-old, who was recently named the best player of the World Cup, has committed to a contract that lasts until 2030. He joins his international teammates in Barcelona, expressing his excitement to play for the Catalan club after completing his medical exams.
amharic: ኤፍ ሲ ባርሴሎና የስፔኑን ኮከብ አማካኝ ሮድሪን ከማንቸስተር ሲቲ በ76.5 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ በይፋ አስፈርሟል። የ30 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች በቅርቡ የአለም ዋንጫ ኮከብ ተጫዋች በመሆን የተመረጠ ሲሆን እስከ 2030 የሚቆይ ውል ተፈራርሟል። ሮድሪ ወደ ባርሴሎና በመቀላቀሉ የተሰማውን ደስታ የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ የህክምና ምርመራውን በማጠናቀቅ ከስፔን ብሄራዊ ቡድን አጋሮቹ ጋር ተቀላቅሏል።
oromo: FC Barcelona taphataa giddu galeessa biyya Spain kan ta'e Rodri Manchester City irraa qarshii yuroo miliyoona 76.5n ifatti mallatteessiseera. Taphataan umurii 30 kun, kan dhiheenya kana taphataa guddicha wancaa addunyaa ta'ee badhaafame, hanga bara 2030tti turuuf waliigaltee raawwateera. Rodri garee Barcelona kanatti makamuusaatiin gammachuu isaa ibsee, qormaata fayyaa booda hiriyoota garee biyyaalessaa isaa waliin leenjii jalqabuuf qophii ta'uu beeksiseera.

title: Nigeria hospital collapses after rain washed away its foundations
english: A hospital building in Nigeria recently collapsed after heavy rains caused a landslide that undermined its structure. Fortunately, local residents noticed warning signs beforehand, which allowed for the successful evacuation of everyone inside. No casualties were reported as a result of the incident.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ የሚገኝ አንድ ሆስፒታል በከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተፈጠረ የመሬት መንሸራተት ተደርምሷል። አካባቢው ነዋሪዎች የህንጻውን መፍረስ አስቀድመው በመገንዘባቸው በሆስፒታሉ ውስጥ የነበሩ ሰዎችን በሰላም ማስወጣት ተችሏል። በደረሰው የህንጻ መፍረስ አደጋም ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት አልጠፋም።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaatti hospitaalli tokko rooba cimaan lafti akka sigigaatu waan godheef caccabeera. Namoonni naannichaa mallattoon rakkoo mul'achuu isaa hubatanii namoota hospitaalicha keessa turan hunda yeroo isaanii eeggatanii waan baasaniif miidhaan lubbuu hin geessisne.

title: Analysis: Syrian airbase attack is an Israeli message to Damascus, Ankara
english: Recent Israeli airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur airbase in Syria are viewed by experts as a deliberate warning to prevent the new Syrian government from restoring its aerial military capabilities. By targeting key infrastructure, Israel aims to maintain regional dominance and signal its disapproval to both Damascus and its ally, Turkiye. These actions reflect Israel's ongoing efforts to weaken Syrian military strength and influence in the post-Assad era.
amharic: በሶሪያ አቡ አል-ዱሁር የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የተፈጸመው የእስራኤል ጥቃት፣ አዲሱ የሶሪያ መንግስት የአየር ኃይሉን እንዳያደራጅ ለማስጠንቀቅ የተወሰደ እርምጃ እንደሆነ ተንታኞች ይገልጻሉ። እስራኤል በዚህ ድርጊቷ የሶሪያን ወታደራዊ አቅም በመገደብ ለደማስቆ እና ለቱርክ መልእክት እያስተላለፈች ነው። ይህ ጥቃት በባሻር አል-አሳድ መውደቅ በኋላ በእስራኤል እና በሶሪያ መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት የበለጠ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Humni qilleensaa Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Abu al-Duhur kan Siiriyaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuun ishee, mootummaan Siiriyaa haaraan humna qilleensaa isaa akka hin ijaarre akeekkachiisa kennuuf akka ta'e ogeeyyiin ibsu. Haleellaan kun dhaabbata waraanaa Siiriyaa laaffisuufi biyyattii akkasumas michuu ishee Turkiif ergaa dabarsuuf kan qophaaye dha. Tarkaanfiin kun yeroo booda mootummaa Baashar al-Assad booda walitti dhufeenya Israa'elifi Siiriyaa gidduu jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: The British state has recast protest as terrorism
english: British legislation now defines property damage committed for political or ideological reasons as terrorism, significantly expanding the scope of counterterrorism laws beyond violent acts. Critics, including legal experts and human rights advocates, argue this broad interpretation unfairly equates civil protest and activism with criminal terrorism. This shift has fundamentally changed how the government and courts interact with demonstrators and political dissenters in the UK.

title: Iran prepares to keep economy alive as US threatens further sanctions
english: The United States is preparing to impose unprecedented economic sanctions against Iran as part of an ongoing naval blockade and trade embargo. In response, Iranian officials are maintaining a defiant stance, suggesting they may shift toward offensive military operations to challenge the restrictions. Experts note that Tehran currently appears more likely to prioritize breaking the blockade through conflict rather than surrendering to American terms.

title: Disney sues US regulator, claiming political retaliation over ABC stations
english: Disney has filed a lawsuit against the Federal Communications Commission, accusing the Trump administration of using license renewal requirements to punish ABC for its news coverage. The network claims the government is attempting to intimidate them due to political frustration with their reporting and commentary. While the FCC argues the decision relates to internal company practices, Disney maintains that the early review is a retaliatory move meant to undermine their journalistic independence.
amharic: ዲስኒ በኤቢሲ የዜና ሽፋን ምክንያት የአሜሪካ መንግስት የፍቃድ ማደሻ ደንቦችን በመጠቀም ጫና እያደረገበት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ክስ መስርቷል። ኩባንያው መንግስት በሪፖርታቸው እና በአስተያየታቸው በመበሳጨት ለማስፈራራት እየሞከረ እንደሆነ ይከራከራል። የፌደራል ኮሙዩኒኬሽን ኮሚሽን ውሳኔው ከኩባንያው ውስጣዊ አሰራር ጋር የተያያዘ ነው ቢልም፣ ዲስኒ ይህ እርምጃ የጋዜጠኝነት ነጻነታቸውን ለመገደብ የታለመ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሆነ ይገልጻል።
oromo: Disney mootummaan Donald Trump gabaasa oduu ABC irratti mufachuudhaan, hayyama isaanirraa fudhachuuf yaalaa jira jechuun himannaa dhiyeesseera. Inni kun hojii gaazexeessummaa isaanii irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf kan godhame akka ta'e Disney ibseera. Komishiniin Komunikeeshinii Federaalaa (FCC) tarkaanfichi kan dhufe haala hojii keessoo dhaabbatichaa wajjin walqabatee akka ta'e dubbatus, Disney garuu tarkaanfichi bilisummaa isaanii xuquuf kan fudhatamee fi kanneen isaanitti tooluu didan irratti haaloo bahuuf kan karoorfame akka ta'e himata.

title: Two children shot by Israeli forces in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid on the Am’ari refugee camp in the occupied West Bank on Tuesday. During the operation, soldiers opened fire on two children, leaving one of them in serious condition. Palestinian medical personnel confirmed the incident occurred in the el-Bireh area near Ramallah.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ማክሰኞ ዕለት በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በሚገኘው የአማሪ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ወረራ አድርገዋል። በዚህ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት ወታደሮች በሁለት ህጻናት ላይ ጥይት በመተኮሳቸው አንደኛው ለከባድ ጉዳት ተዳርጓል። የፍልስጤም የህክምና ምንጮች ይህ ክስተት የተፈጸመው በራማላህ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው ኤል-ቢሬህ አካባቢ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa Israa'el Kibxata darbe naannoo Qilleensaa keessatti argamu buufata baqattootaa Am'arii irratti haleellaa raawwate. Haleellaa kanaan yeroo waraanni dhukaasa banetti ijoolleen lama miidhamanii, isa tokko irratti miidhaan cimaan ga'eera. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa Falasxiin akka mirkaneessanitti, miidhaan kun kan qaqqabe naannoo magaalaa Raamallaahitti argamu El-Biiree keessatti dha.

title: UAE says Iran fired two ballistic missiles at territory
english: The United Arab Emirates defense ministry reported that two ballistic missiles launched from Iran were detected heading toward their territory on Tuesday. One missile landed outside the country's territorial waters, while the second fell within them. UAE officials stated that they remain on high alert and are fully prepared to address any further security threats.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ማክሰኞ ዕለት ከኢራን የተተኮሱ ሁለት ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎች ወደ ግዛታቸው መቃረቡን አስታውቋል። የመጀመሪያው ሚሳኤል ከሀገሪቱ የባህር ወሰን ውጭ የወደቀ ሲሆን ሁለተኛው ደግሞ በባህር ወሰን ውስጥ መውደቁ ተረጋግጧል። ኤምሬቶች ማንኛውንም አይነት የጸጥታ ስጋት ለመመከት ከፍተኛ ዝግጅት ማድረጋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Emireetota Arabaa Gamtaa akka jedhetti, Kibxata darbe misayiloonni balistikii lama kanneen Iiraan irraa dhukaafaman gara biyyattii qajeelanii turan. Misayilichi inni tokko daangaa bishaan biyyattii ala kan kufu yoo ta'u, inni lammaffaan garuu daangaa bishaan keessatti kuteera. Mootummaan Emireetotaa balaa kamiyyuu ittisuuf qophiin isaa cimaa akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Kariba ferry death toll rises to 93, making it Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster
english: A ferry accident on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has claimed 93 lives, marking the country's worst transport tragedy. The vessel was significantly overloaded with passengers and cargo when it capsized due to strong waves, making life-saving equipment inaccessible. Search efforts are ongoing, though authorities now face challenges identifying victims due to the condition of the bodies and may require DNA testing.
amharic: በዚምባብዌ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ የደረሰው የጀልባ አደጋ 93 ሰዎችን በመቅጠፍ የአገሪቱ እጅግ አሳዛኝ የመጓጓዣ አደጋ ሆኗል። ጀልባዋ ከተፈቀደላት አቅም በላይ ተሳፋሪዎችን እና እቃዎችን ጭና በመጓዝ ላይ ሳለች በጠንካራ ማዕበል ተገልብጣለች። የነፍስ አድን ስራው እየቀጠለ ቢሆንም፣ የሟቾችን ማንነት ለመለየት አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ የዲኤንኤ ምርመራ ሊያስፈልግ እንደሚችል ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa fi biyyoota ollaa keessatti balaan markabaa haro Karibaa keessatti mudate lubbuu namoota 93 kan galaafate yoo ta'u, kun balaa geejjiba biyyattii keessatti mudate keessaa isa hamaadha. Markabatti namoota hedduu fi meeshaalee baay'ee fe'uun isaa fi qilleensi cimaan akka inni gombifamu taasiseera. Hojii barbaacha fi foon namoota du'anii funaanuu ammayyuu kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, qaamni namoota du'anii adda baasuun rakkisaa waan ta'eef qorannoon DNA barbaachisuu danda'a.

title: Real Madrid officially present Mourinho in bizarre closed-door ceremony
english: Jose Mourinho has officially returned to Real Madrid as manager, signing a contract that keeps him with the club until 2029. Unlike the usual grand presentations, his appointment was marked by a quiet, private ceremony at the team's training facility. Mourinho expressed that coming back feels deeply personal and emotional as he looks to lead the team following a period of high-profile new signings and trophy droughts.
amharic: ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የሪያል ማድሪድ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው በይፋ ተሹመዋል። አሰልጣኙ እስከ 2029 ዓ.ም የሚያቆያቸውን ውል የተፈራረሙ ሲሆን፣ የዝግጅቱ አቀራረብ ከተለመደው ትልቅ ደማቅ ስነ-ስርዓት በተለየ መልኩ በለስላሳ እና በግል የተከናወነ ነበር። ሞሪንሆ ወደ ክለቡ መመለሳቸው ትልቅ ስሜታዊ ትርጉም እንዳለው ገልጸው፣ በክለቡ ላይ የነበረውን የዋንጫ ድርቅ ለመስበር ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Jose Mourinho yeroo lammaffaaf leenjisaa Real Madrid ta'uun isaanii ifa ta'eera, kanaanis hanga bara 2029 turuuf waliigalteerra ga'aniiru. Sirni beekamtii isaa kan duraan akka amala Real Madrid'tti mallattoo guddaa hin qabne, kanaa mannaa iddoo leenjiitti haala calliinsaan raawwatameera. Mourinho gara Real Madrid deebi'uun isaa miira guddaa akka isaaf qabu ibsuun, garee kana keessatti milkaa'ina haaraa galmeessisuuf akka hojjetu dubbateera.

title: Spain builds tent cities for the thousands stuck in Ceuta
english: Spain is establishing four temporary tent settlements in Ceuta to provide shelter for approximately 1,500 migrants. This move follows a massive influx of over 72,000 people from Morocco in July, leaving thousands currently stranded in the city. Many of these individuals are residing in improvised camps on beaches while hoping to secure employment within Europe.
amharic: ስፔን በሴውታ ከተማ ለተጠለሉ ወደ 1,500 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች መጠለያ እንዲሆን አራት ጊዜያዊ የድንኳን ከተሞችን እየገነባች ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በሐምሌ ወር ብቻ ከሞሮኮ ከ72,000 በላይ ሰዎች ድንበር ተሻግረው በመግባታቸው ሳቢያ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት በከተማዋ የቀሩት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች በአውሮፓ ውስጥ ሥራ ለማግኘት በመጠባበቅ ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ አብዛኛዎቹም በባህር ዳርቻዎች በተዘጋጁ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ ይኖራሉ።
oromo: Ispeeniin godaantota gara 1,500 ta'anf magaalaa Se'utaa keessatti lafa dunkaanotaa yeroo arfanii ijaaraa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame ji'a Adoolessaa keessa namoonni 72,000 ol ta'an biyya Morookoo irraa daangaa ce'anii seenuun isaanii hordofee dha. Namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman ammas magaala kana keessatti kan argaman yoo ta'u, isaanis Awurooppaa keessatti hojii argachuuf abdii qabachaa, bakkeewwan yeroo qarqara galaanaatti ijaaraman keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: Palestinian living in caves older than Israel
english: Farhan al Rashaydeh and his family reside in a cave located in the occupied West Bank. Although they have grown fond of their home, they were forced to live there because Israeli authorities rarely grant Palestinians permission to build houses. This situation highlights the significant challenges Palestinians face due to strict construction regulations in the region.
amharic: ፋርሃን አል-ራሻይዴህ እና ቤተሰቡ በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ በሚገኝ ዋሻ ውስጥ ይኖራሉ። ምንም እንኳን ቤታቸውን ቢወዱትም፣ በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ጥብቅ የህንጻ ግንባታ ህግ ምክንያት ፍቃድ ማግኘት ስላልቻሉ በዋሻው ውስጥ ለመኖር ተገደዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚደርሰውን የቤት ግንባታ ተግዳሮት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Farhaan Al-Rashaaydeh fi maatiin isaa qarqara ganda Weest Baank keessatti holqa keessa jiraatu. Manasaanii kana jaallatanis, mootummaan Israa'el hayyama ijaarsa manaa akka hin kennineef dirqamanii holqa keessa jiraachuu filataniiru. Haalli kun rakkina ijoolleen Falasxiin seera ijaarsa manaa cimaa ta'een kanneen mudatan mul'isa.

title: “I fear for my family’s lives” says Loui Ridi as settlers besiege home
english: Loui Ridi, a Palestinian-American, is fearing for his family’s safety as Israeli settlers surround their home in Qusra. The settlers have already seized a neighbor's property and are moving through the area without facing any opposition. Ridi has displayed an American flag outside his house in an urgent attempt to draw attention and support from United States authorities.
amharic: ፓሌስታናዊ አሜሪካዊው ሉዊ ሪዲ በኩስራ በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤታቸው ላይ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች ከበው በመገኘታቸው ለቤተሰባቸው ደህንነት እንደሚሰጉ ተናግረዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ ቀደም ሲል የጎረቤታቸውን ቤት ተቆጣጥረው ያለ ምንም ተቃውሞ በአካባቢው እየተንቀሳቀሱ ይገኛሉ። ሪዲ የአሜሪካን ባንዲራ በቤታቸው ላይ በማውለብለብ ከአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ፈጣን ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Namni lammii Amerikaa fi Palastiinii ta'e Loui Ridi, qubsattoonni Israa'el mana isaa kan Qusra keessatti argamu marsuun isaanii maatii isaa irratti soda guddaa uumeera. Qubsattoonni kunneen mana ollaa isaa to'annaa jala galchuun, sodaa tokko malee naannichatti socho'aa jiru. Ridi, gargaarsa mootummaa Amerikaa argachuuf jecha alaabaa Amerikaa manasaa irratti olcheera.

title: Six killed in Israeli air strike on Gaza City, including a child
english: At least six people, including a child, were killed in an Israeli air strike targeting a cafe in Gaza City. The force of the attack knocked several victims into the sea, prompting an ongoing search and recovery operation. Additionally, about a dozen people were injured in the strike and are receiving medical treatment at al-Shifa Hospital.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኝ ካፌ ላይ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ህጻንን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የጥቃቱ አሰቃቂነት በርካታ ሰዎችን ወደ ባህር ውስጥ የጣለ ሲሆን፣ የአስከሬን ፍለጋ ስራዎች በመካሄድ ላይ ይገኛሉ። እንዲሁም በአስራ ሁለት የሚገመቱ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በአል-ሺፋ ሆስፒታል ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gaazaatti kaafe tokko irratti xiyyaarri waraana Israa'el erga haleelee booda, ijoollee dabalatee namoonni jahaan lubbuun darbaniiru. Humna haleellaa kanaan namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e tokko tokko gara galaanaatti darbatamanii jiru; kanaafis hojiin reeffa barbaaduu itti fufee jira. Kanas malee, namoonni kudha lama ta'an miidhamanii hospitaala Al-Shifaa keessatti yaalamaa jiru.

title: Yemeni forces shoot down Houthi drone in Hadramout
english: Yemeni government forces, supported by Saudi Arabia, successfully intercepted and destroyed a suspected Houthi drone near a military base in the Hadramout region. Simultaneously, the Yemeni government launched its own series of drone strikes targeting Houthi strongholds across multiple areas in the Shabwa governorate. These events mark a continuation of the ongoing military tensions between the two opposing sides in Yemen.

english: Many Egyptians living and working in the United Arab Emirates are concerned after reports that numerous residency permits were suddenly cancelled without explanation. While there has been no official change in policy, the uncertainty has led many workers to avoid traveling abroad for fear of losing their legal standing in the UAE.

Reaching a final resolution on this strategic waterway is viewed as a necessary step to ease regional tensions and bring the involved parties back to the negotiating table.

oromo: Qatar akka jedhutti, walii galteen biyyoota Iraan fi Omaan gidduutti qarqara galaana Hormuz irratti taasifamu, marii diploomaasii kan Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhamu deebisuuf baay'ee barbaachisaa dha. Biyyoonni lamaan kun karaa galaana sanaa fayyadamuu irratti mari'achaa jiranis, rakkoon bulchiinsa fi nageenyaa marii isaanii gufachiisee ture. Iddoo strateejii kana irratti walii galuun, waldhabdee naannichaa hir'isee garee hunda mariif gadi taa'uuf akka isaan gargaaru ibsameera.

title: Qatar: Iran’s claim that Doha is holding missing pilots is a ‘media ploy’
english: The Qatari Foreign Ministry has officially rejected accusations from Iran that Doha is detaining missing Iranian pilots. Qatar dismissed these claims as a public relations stunt and noted that Iran has ignored requests to provide evidence for their statements. The government insists that the allegations are completely false.
amharic: የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ዶሃ የጠፉ የኢራን አብራሪዎችን በእጇ ይዛለች የሚለውን የኢራን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ኳታር ይህንን የኢራን ወንጀል እንደ ሚዲያ ፕሮፓጋንዳ የገለጸችው ሲሆን፣ ኢራን ክሱን ለማረጋገጥ ለቀረበላት ጥሪ ምላሽ ባለመስጠቷ ነው። መንግሥቱ የቀረበው ክስ ከእውነት የራቀ መሆኑን በድጋሚ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa Qatar himata Iran, Doha keessatti ooftonni xiyyaaraa Iran kan dhabaman to'annoo Qatar jiru jechuun dhiyeessite dhugaa akka hin taane ibseera. Qatar himata kana akka malaatti fayyadamuu miidiyaa (media ploy) jechuun kan ibsite yoo ta'u, Iran ragaa dhiyeessuuf afeertee kan didde ta'uu beeksisiteetti. Mootummaan Qatar himatichi guutummaatti soba ta'uu irra deebiin mirkaneesseera.

title: Palestinian-American confronts Israeli settler at his besieged home
english: Loui Abu Ridi, a Palestinian-American, confronted an Israeli settler after discovering his property in Qusra had been damaged upon his return from the United States. This incident occurs as three Palestinian households in the area have faced a persistent ten-day siege by settlers. The situation highlights the ongoing tensions and security challenges faced by residents in the Nablus region.
amharic: አሜሪካዊው ፍልስጤማዊ ሉዊ አቡ ሪዲ ከአሜሪካ ወደ ቤቱ ሲመለስ ንብረቱ መጎዳቱን በመመልከት በእስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪ ላይ ተቃውሞ አሰምቷል። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው በናብለስ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በሚገኘው ኩስራ አካባቢ ሶስት የፍልስጤም ቤቶች ለአስር ቀናት ያህል በሰፋሪዎች በተከበቡበት ወቅት ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የጸጥታ ስጋት እና ከፍተኛ ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Namni lammii Ameerikaa fi Falastiinii kan ta'e Luwii Abuu Ridi, biyya Ameerikaa irraa gara mana isaa yeroo deebi'u qabeenyi isaa manca'uu erga argee booda, sanyii Israa'el tokko irratti mormii dhageessise. Kuni kan ta'e, naannoo magaalaa Naablus, mandara Qusraa jedhamutti mana maatii Falastiinii sadii guyyaa kudhaniif sanyiin Israa'el marsanii turan keessatti. Gochi kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti ummata irratti raawwatamaa jiru ifa godha.

title: Who is Wassim al-Assad, sentenced to death for Syria war atrocities?
english: Wassim al-Assad, a cousin of former Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, has been sentenced to death for his role in war crimes, including murder and torture. He was found guilty of leading pro-regime paramilitary groups that carried out brutal attacks against civilians during the 14-year conflict. This ruling follows similar death sentences handed down to other top regime officials, including the former president, as part of Syria's new transitional government's push for justice.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሶሪያ ፕሬዝዳንት ባሽር አል-አሳድ የአጎት ልጅ የሆነው ዋሲም አል-አሳድ በጦር ወንጀል፣ በግድያ እና በስቃይ ድርጊቶች ጥፋተኛ ተብሎ የሞት ፍርድ ተፈረደበት። ዋሲም በሶሪያ የ14 ዓመት የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት በሲቪል ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጭካኔ የተሞላባቸው ጥቃቶችን የሚያደርሱ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን በመምራት ወንጀል ተከሷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ጨምሮ ሌሎች ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት የሞት ፍርድ ከተላለፈባቸው ሳምንት በኋላ የተሰጠ ሲሆን፣ አዲሱ የሶሪያ ሽግግር መንግስት የፍትህ ሂደቱን አጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Wassim al-Assad, ilma abbaa warra duraanii Bashar al-Assad kan ta'e, yakka waraanaa, ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwateen du'atti murame. Inni garee waraanaa mootummaa deggeruun namoota nagaa irratti haleellaa suukanneessaa raawwatan hogganuun himatamee jira. Murtuun kun namoota biroo, kanneen akka dursaa biyyattii kanaan duraa irratti erga dabarfamee torban tokko booda kan dhufe yoo ta'u, mootummaan ce'umsaa haaraan kan Sooriyaa kun sirna haqaa mirkaneessuuf tarkaanfii fudhachaa jira.

title: Japanese activist keeps protesting against Israel’s genocide in Gaza
english: Japanese activist Yusuke Furusawa has been staging daily solo protests to show his opposition to the ongoing violence in Gaza. Despite visible exhaustion, he continues to sit in the streets and publicly call for Palestinian freedom. His persistent commitment has gained attention through social media as he remains dedicated to his cause.
amharic: የጃፓኑ አክቲቪስት ዩሱኬ ፉሩሳዋ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት በመቃወም በየቀኑ ብቻውን ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ እያደረገ ይገኛል። ምንም እንኳን በከፍተኛ ድካም ውስጥ ቢሆንም፣ በመንገድ ላይ በመቀመጥ ለፍልስጤም ነፃነት ድምፁን ማሰማቱን ቀጥሏል። የእሱ ይህ ተከታታይ ትግል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አማካኝነት የብዙዎችን ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Duudha-falmaa lammii Jaappaan kan ta'e Yusuke Furusawa, waraana Gaza keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru mormuuf guyyuu kophaa isaa hiriira ba'aa jira. Hamma dadhabuu isaatti kan mul'atu ta'us, karaa irra taa'uun mirga falastinootaatiif sagalee isaa dhageessisuu itti fufeera. Tattaaffiin isaa kunis miidiyaalee hawaasummaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo hedduu argachuu danda'eera.

title: Qatar rejects Iran’s ‘false’ claims about missing pilots
english: Qatar has dismissed Iran's accusations that it is secretly detaining three military pilots whose planes crashed during the ongoing conflict. Qatari officials stated that the allegations are entirely false, noting that they already returned the remains of one recovered pilot earlier this year. Doha maintained that the Iranian aircraft were shot down for violating Qatari airspace and dismissed Tehran's claims as an unfounded media strategy.
amharic: ኳታር በጦርነቱ ወቅት የሶስት ኢራናዊያን ወታደራዊ አብራሪዎችን በምስጢር ይዛለች የሚለውን የኢራን ክስ አጣጥላለች። የኳታር መንግስት ይህ የኢራን ክስ መሰረተ ቢስ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ ቀደም ሲል አንድ አብራሪ መገኘቱንና አስከሬኑም ለኢራን መሰጠቱን አስታውቋል። የኳታር ባለስልጣናት አውሮፕላኖቹ የአገሪቱን የአየር ክልል ጥሰው በመግባታቸው እንደተመቱና ኢራን የምታቀርበው ክስ ከእውነት የራቀ የፖለቲካ ፕሮፓጋንዳ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Qatar himata Iraan gama qilleensaa biyyattii cabsuun xiyyaara kukkufu keessatti qabaman jedhaman sadan dhoksaan hidheera jedhu haaltee jirti. Mootummaan Qatar himatni kun sobaafi bu'uura kan hin qabne ta'uu eeruun, kanaan dura qaamni qooda xiyyaara tokkoo argamee gara Iraanitti erguusaa ibseera. Qatar xiyyaarotni kunneen daangaa qilleensaa biyyattii waan cabsaniif tarkaanfiin irratti fudhatame jedhuun, himatni Iraan shira miidiyaa fi waa'ee lafa hin qabne ta'uusaa ibsiteetti.

title: Myanmar: The Architecture of Statelessness
english: The documentary examines how Myanmar's military systematically stripped the Rohingya people of their citizenship through discriminatory laws and strict movement controls. It details the brutal 2016-2017 military operations that forced hundreds of thousands to flee to Bangladesh amid mass killings and village burnings. The film currently explores the ongoing genocide case against Myanmar at the International Court of Justice to determine if these actions constitute legal genocide.
amharic: ይህ ዘጋቢ ፊልም የብሔርተኛ የሆኑ የዜግነት ህጎችን በመጠቀም የሮሂንጃ ህዝብ እንዴት ዜግነታቸውን እንደተነጠቁ እና እንቅስቃሴያቸው እንደተገደበ ያሳያል። እ.ኤ.አ በ2016 እና 2017 የተፈፀሙትን ግድያዎች እና የጅምላ መፈናቀል በማስረጃ በማቅረብ፣ ይህ ድርጊት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ በአለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት እየተካሄደ ያለውን ሂደት ይዳስሳል። የወቅቱ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔም ለሮሂንጃ ህዝብ እጣ ፈንታ ትልቅ ትርጉም ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Fiilmiin kun mootummaan Myanmar seera biyyaalessummaa jijjiiruun saba Rohinjaa mirga isaanii akkam akka sarbe ibsa. Waraanni waggaa 2016 fi 2017 keessa raawwate lubbuu galaafachuu fi namoota kumaatamaan baqachiisuun kan beekamu yoo ta'u, gochi kun yakka sanyii balleessuu ta'uu fi dhiisuu isaa Mana Murtii Addunyaatti falmii taasisaa jiru. Fiilmiin kun dhaddachi kun murtoo maalii akka kennu fi bu'aan isaa maal akka ta'u qorata.

title: Trump posts map labelling Strait of Hormuz as 'new US territory'
english: Former U.S. President Donald Trump shared an image on social media claiming the Strait of Hormuz is now American territory. The post featured a map of this critical maritime route, which is responsible for transporting a significant portion of the world's oil supply. He provided no further context or explanation for the controversial image.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የአሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሆነ የሚያሳይ ምስል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለቀዋል። ይህ የባህር መስመር የአለምን የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ትልቅ ክፍል የሚያስተላልፍ ስልታዊ ቦታ ነው። ትራምፕ ለዚህ ምስል ምንም አይነት ተጨማሪ ማብራሪያ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp, handaara Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz) amma qabeenya Ameerikaa akka ta'e ibsuudhaan suuraa miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti gadhiisaniiru. Daandiin galaanaa kun dhiyeessii boba'aa addunyaa keessaa harka guddaa kan qabatuudha. Tiraamp waa'ee suuraa kanaa irratti ibsa dabalataa tokkollee hin kennine.

title: Israeli soldiers number Palestinian detainees on their foreheads
english: Israeli soldiers recently detained dozens of Palestinians during a military raid in the West Bank town of Qabatiya. The detainees were forcibly marked with identification numbers on their foreheads and arms by the military. Survivors claim these actions were intended to intimidate local families and discourage resistance against nearby settlement expansions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በምዕራብ ባንክ በምትገኘው በቃባቲያ ከተማ ባደረጉት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ወታደሮቹ የታሰሩትን ሰዎች ግንባር እና ክንድ ላይ ቁጥሮችን በመፃፍ ምልክት አድርገውባቸዋል። ተጎጂዎች እንደገለፁት ይህ ድርጊት የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ለማስፈራራት እና በሰፈራ መስፋፋት ላይ ያላቸውን ተቃውሞ ለማዳከም የታለመ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el magaalaa Qabaatiyaa kan Qarqara Lixaa keessatti argamtu keessatti namoota Falasxiin hedduu hidhatti gurguree jira. Waraanni kun namoota hidhaman kana irraatti lakkoofsa barreessuun fuula fi harka isaanii irratti mallattoo godhaniiru. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e akka jedhanitti, gochi kun maatiiwwan achi jiraatan sodaachisuufi babal'ina qe'ee qonnaan bulaa naannichaa mormuu irraa isaan dhaabuuf kan godhame dha.

title: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'
english: Former professional boxer Wladimir Klitschko has expressed deep sadness following the passing of his ex-partner, actress Hayden Panettiere, at age 36. Although authorities have found no signs of foul play, reports indicate she may have suffered a cardiac arrest. Klitschko, who shares a daughter with the late star, stated that he remains committed to honoring her memory for their child while grieving alongside her family.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቦክስ ሻምፒዮን ቭላድሚር ክሊችኮ የልጃቸው እናት የሆኑት ተዋናይዋ ሃይደን ፓኔቲየር በ36 ዓመታቸው በሞት በመለየታቸው ጥልቅ ሐዘን እንደተሰማው ገልጿል። ባለሥልጣናት በሟች ላይ ምንም ዓይነት የወንጀል ድርጊት አለመኖሩን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የሕክምና ዘገባዎች ግን በልብ ድካም ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይጠቁማሉ። ክሊችኮ ከቀድሞ አጋሩ ጋር ያላቸውን ልጅ በማስታወስ፣ የልጁ እናት ያሳለፈችውን መልካም ጊዜ ሁሌም እንደሚያስታውስ ተናግሯል።
oromo: Leenji'aa fi taphataa sababaa boksiin beekamu Wladimir Klitschko, haati ijoollee isaa fi aktarriin Hayden Panettiere umurii waggaa 36tti du'uu isheetti gadda guddaa itti dhaga'ame ibseera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa duuti ishee walqabatee yakki kamiyyuu akka hin jiraanne mirkaneessanillee, gabaasni tokko tokko duuti ishee dhukkuba onnee wajjin walqabachuu danda'a jedhu. Klitschko haadha ijoollee isaa yeroo darbe kabajaan akka yaadatuu fi maatii ishee wajjin gadda ishee akka qooddatu ibseera.

title: Russia protests Japan PM’s comments after Putin’s Kuril visit
english: Russia has summoned the Japanese ambassador to express formal disapproval after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi criticized President Vladimir Putin's recent visit to the disputed Kuril Islands. Japan views the islands as its sovereign territory and considers the Russian leader's trip completely unacceptable, further straining already tense diplomatic relations. This confrontation highlights the ongoing conflict over these islands, which has prevented the two nations from establishing a formal peace treaty since World War II.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን በኩሪል ደሴቶች ላይ ያደረጉትን ጉብኝት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳናኤ ታካይቺ በመተቸታቸው ሩሲያ በሞስኮ የሚገኙትን የጃፓን አምባሳደር ጠርታ ተቃውሞዋን ገለጸች። ጃፓን ደሴቶቹ የራሷ ግዛት እንደሆኑ ታምናለች፤ የሩሲያ መሪ ጉብኝትም ተቀባይነት የሌለው ድርጊት መሆኑን በመግለጽ两国 መካከል ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ይበልጥ አባብሳዋለች። ይህ አለመግባባት ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የሰላም ስምምነት እንዳይፈረም እንቅፋት የሆነውን የረጅም ጊዜ የግዛት ክርክር እንደገና አግልግሏል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Wlaadimiir Puutiin daawwannaa isaan gamoowwan Kuril irratti taasisan ilaalchisee, Ministirri Muummee Saana'e Taakaayichii yaada isaan kennan mormuun, Raashiyaan ambaasaaddara Jaappaan kan Mooskootti argaman waamtee mormii ishee ibsiteetti. Jaappaan gamoowwan kunneen kan ishee akka ta'an amanti, daawwannaan hoogganaa Raashiyaa kunis fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii kan caalaatti dhiphiseedha. Walitti bu'iinsi kun, gamoowwan kunneen irratti wal dhabdeen jiru sun, waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda biyyoota lamaan gidduutti waliigaltee nagaa akka hin mallatteeffamne gufuu ta'aa akka ture yaadachiisa.

title: Why has Trump threatened to bomb Oman – for a second time?
english: President Donald Trump has threatened to bomb Oman, a neutral US ally, if the nation interferes with his efforts to negotiate a deal with Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz. These threats follow the collapse of recent peace talks between Washington and Tehran. Despite Oman’s efforts to act as a mediator, Trump has repeatedly warned that he would use military force against the country to ensure his objectives are met.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኦማን በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ባለው የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ድርድር ላይ ጣልቃ ከገባች በቦምብ እንደሚደበድቡ ዝተዋል። ኦማን በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል እንደ ገለልተኛ አደራዳሪ ለመስራት ብትሞክርም፣ ትራምፕ ይህንን የራሳቸውን ዓላማ ለማሳካት እንደ ማሰናከያ በመቁጠር ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ተናግረዋል። ይህ የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ሲያደርጉት የቆዩት ተደጋጋሚ ማስፈራሪያ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው የሰላም ንግግር በመቋረጡ ምክንያት የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Traamp biyyi Oomaan gidduu seentee dhimma naannoo galaana Hormuuz irratti marii Ameerikaanii fi Iraan gidduu jiru gufachiiste akka boombiin rukutamu doorsisaniiru. Oomaan biyya Ameerikaa waliin michuu taatee fi walakkeessa taatee giddutti seenuuf yaaltus, Traamp karoora isaanii galmaan ga'uuf jecha biyyattii irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf wadaata seeneera. Doorsisni kun mariin nagaa Ameerikaanii fi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa ture erga fashaleen booda kan hordofe dha.

title: Premier League what to know: Schedule, prediction, transfers and more
english: The 2026-27 Premier League season kicks off this weekend with defending champions Arsenal facing Coventry City in the opening match. While Arsenal is favored to win again, they face early challenges, including a key injury to defender William Saliba. Meanwhile, several other top clubs like Manchester City, Chelsea, and Liverpool are entering the season under new management, making the title race highly competitive.
amharic: የ2026-27 የእንግሊዝ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ውድድር በዚህ ሳምንት መጨረሻ ላይ ዋንጫ ተከላካዩ አርሰናል ከኮቨንትሪ ሲቲ ጋር በሚያደርጉት ጨዋታ ይጀመራል። አርሰናል ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ዋንጫውን ለማንሳት ተመራጭ ቢሆንም፣ የተከላካዩ ዊሊያም ሳሊባ ጉዳት ለቡድኑ ፈተና ሆኖባቸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ማንቸስተር ሲቲ፣ ቼልሲ እና ሊቨርፑልን ጨምሮ በርካታ ታላላቅ ክለቦች በአዲስ አሰልጣኞች ውድድሩን ስለሚጀምሩ የዘንድሮው የሊጉ ፉክክር እጅግ ተጠባቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Barri dorgommii Priimiyar Liigii Ingilizii bara 2026-27 torban dhufu jalqaba yoo ta'u, taphni jalqabaa qophii eegduu Arsenaal fi Koventirii Siitii gidduutti kan gaggeeffamu ta'a. Arsenaal deebisee waancicha injifachuuf kan eegamu ta'us, miidhama taphataa ittisaa Wiiliyaam Saaliibaa dabalatee rakkoolee mudachuu danda'u. Gama biraatiin, kilaboonni gurguddoon akka Manchestara Siitii, Cheelsii fi Liivarpool leenjistoota haaraa waliin dorgommii kana waan jalqabaniif, morkiin waancichaa baay'ee cimaa ta'a jedhamee eegama.

title: What to know about California’s special election to replace Eric Swalwell
english: Voters in California's 14th District are casting ballots in a special election to choose a successor for former Representative Eric Swalwell, who resigned earlier this year. The race between State Senator Aisha Wahab and local official Melissa Hernandez has become a heated battleground, heavily influenced by millions of dollars in outside spending. This contest highlights significant divisions within the Democratic Party, particularly regarding foreign policy and legislative priorities.
amharic: የካሊፎርኒያ 14ኛው ወረዳ መራጮች ቀደም ብለው ከስልጣን ለለቀቁት የቀድሞ ተወካይ ኤሪክ ስዋልዌል ምትክ ለመምረጥ በልዩ ምርጫ ድምጽ እየሰጡ ነው። በግዛቱ ሴናተር አይሻ ዋሃብ እና በአካባቢው ባለስልጣን ሜሊሳ ሄርናንዴዝ መካከል ያለው ውድድር ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የተደረገበት እና እጅግ አወዛጋቢ ሆኗል። ይህ የምርጫ ውድድር በዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ በተለይም በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ እና በህግ አውጭነት ቅድሚያ በሚሰጣቸው ጉዳዮች ላይ ያለውን ልዩነት በግልጽ ያሳያል።
oromo: Meraatonni kutaa 14ffaa Kaalifoorniyaa, bakka bu'aa duraanii Eric Swalwell kan waggaa kana keessa aangoo gadhiisaniif bakka bu'u filachuuf filannoo addaa irratti sagalee kennuutti jiru. Dorgommiin senetarri mootummaa Aisha Wahab fi hojjetaan naannichaa Melissa Hernandez gidduutti godhamaa jiru, qarshii guddaan alaa keessa seenuun akka inni hammaatu ta'eera. Dorgommiin kun garaagarummaa guddaa Paartii Diimookraataayii keessa jiru, keessumaa dhimma siyaasa alaa fi dhimmoota seera baasuu irratti ifatti mul'isa.

title: Tupac Shakur murder trial begins thirty years after his death
english: Thirty years after the death of rapper Tupac Shakur, a trial has finally commenced for Duane 'Keffe D' Davis, the only person to be charged in the case. Prosecutors are building their argument around the former gang leader's own past statements and admissions regarding the 1996 shooting. Conversely, Davis's legal team contends that his previous claims were fabricated for attention.
amharic: ታዋቂው ራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩር ከተገደለ ሠላሳ ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ጉዳዩን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በችሎት የሚያስቀርበው የዱዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስ ክስ ሂደት ተጀምሯል። አቃቤ ህግ የቀድሞው የጋንግ መሪ በራሱ መጽሐፍ እና በተለያዩ ቃለ መጠይቆች ላይ የሰጡትን የእምነት ቃል እንደ ዋና ማስረጃ አቅርበዋል። የዴቪስ ጠበቆች በበኩላቸው ተከሳሹ ቀደም ሲል የሰጡት መግለጫዎች ከእውነት የራቁ እና የፈጠራ ወሬዎች እንደሆኑ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Raappa beekamaa Tupac Shakur erga ajjeefame waggaa soddoma booda, namni tokko qofti shakkamee yakka kanaan himatamee ture Duane 'Keffe D' Davis irratti dhaddachi jalqabameera. Abbaan alangaa himatamaa kanaan dura kitaaba isaa fi mariiwwan garaa garaa irratti ajjeechaa bara 1996 raawwatame ilaalchisee kan dubbate akka ragaatti dhiyeessaa jiru. Gama biraatiin, abukaatonni Davis himatamichi waa'ee ajjeechaa kanaa dura dubbate hundi soba fi of tuulummaa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Israelis are second least wanted migrants in UK after Russians, poll finds
english: A recent YouGov survey indicates that Israelis are the second least desired immigrant group in the UK, trailing only Russians. Nearly half of British respondents expressed a preference for reducing or completely halting Israeli migration to the country. Very few people support increasing the number of Israeli arrivals, highlighting a general trend of public caution regarding immigration from several specific nations.

title: Israelis are second least wanted migrants in UK after Russians, poll finds
english: A recent YouGov survey indicates that Israelis are now the second least desired migrant group in the UK, trailing only Russians. Nearly half of the British public supports restricting or completely stopping Israeli migration, while very few favor increasing it. This shift in sentiment occurs alongside declining diplomatic relations between the two countries, marked by public disagreements between the UK government and Israeli leadership.

oromo: Qorannoon YouGov dhiheenya bahe akka agarsiisutti, Israa'eloonni biyya Ingiliz keessatti erga namoota Ruusiyaa hordofee garee namoota godaananii seenuun isaanii hin barbaadamne keessaa sadarkaa lammaffaa irratti argamu. Jijjiiramni yaada ummataa kun hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru gadi bu'uu fi walitti bu'iinsa dubbii geggeessitoota biyyoota lameenii gidduu jiru wajjin kan wal qabatedha.

title: US Syria envoy says Israeli strikes on Syrian base 'unnecessary escalation'
english: A US envoy has criticized recent Israeli airstrikes on a military base in Syria, labeling the action as an unhelpful move that threatens regional stability. The official expressed significant concern regarding the incident and urged all involved parties to choose diplomacy and rational communication instead of military force. The US government is now calling for restraint to prevent any further escalation of the conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ በሶሪያ ውስጥ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የክልሉን ሰላም የሚያውክ አላስፈላጊ እርምጃ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መንግስት በጉዳዩ ላይ ያላቸውን ከፍተኛ ስጋት በመግለጽ፣ ሁሉም ወገኖች ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ይልቅ በውይይት ችግሮችን እንዲፈቱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ግጭቱ ወደፊት እንዳይባባስ ለማድረግ ያለመ መሆኑን አመልክተዋል።
oromo: Ergamtoonni biyya Ameerikaa haleellaa qilleensa irraa kan Israa'el buufata waraanaa Sooriyaa irratti raawwatte, nageenya naannichaa kan miidhu fi kan hin barbaachifne ta'uu ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa yaadni kun baay'ee akka isaan yaaddesse ibsuun, gareewwan marti waraana caalaa marii fi tasgabbii akka filatan gaafataniiru. Tarkaanfin kun walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa akka hin hammadneef kan yaadame dha.

title: Saudi Arabia deletes 'the Muslims will never give up Jerusalem' from its textbooks
english: Saudi Arabia has updated its school textbooks to remove references such as the claim that Muslims will never surrender Jerusalem, as well as certain religious passages. An Israeli research organization, Impact-se, welcomed these changes, noting that they help diminish hostility and promote a different perspective on religious minorities. However, while the revisions reflect a significant shift in the kingdom's educational approach, the textbooks still refrain from explicitly recognizing Israel on their maps.

oromo: Mootummaan Sa'udii Arabiyaa kitaabota barnootaa ishee keessaa hima 'Muslimoonni Yerusaalem gadi hin dhiisan' jedhuu fi caqasoota amantii tokko tokko haquudhaan jijjiirama gooteetti. Haa ta'u malee, jijjiiramni kun jiraatullee, kitaabota barnootaa keessatti Israa'el kaartaa irratti ifatti kan hin ibsamne ta'uun ishee itti fufeera.

title: Iran parliament speaker Ghalibaf to visit Iraq for talks
english: The Iranian parliament speaker, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, is traveling to Iraq for a two-day visit to lead discussions on regional security and bilateral cooperation. This diplomatic trip occurs at a sensitive time as Baghdad faces pressure to disarm pro-Iranian militias by late September. Additionally, the visit follows a recent drone attack in Iraq's Kurdistan region, which Iran has publicly denied being responsible for.
amharic: የኢራን የፓርላማ አፈጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ በክልሉ ደህንነት እና በሁለቱ ሀገራት ትብብር ላይ ለመወያየት የሁለት ቀን ጉብኝት ለማድረግ ወደ ኢራቅ ያመራሉ። ይህ ጉብኝት የተካሄደው ባግዳድ በኢራን ድጋፍ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን እስከ መስከረም መጨረሻ ድረስ ትጥቅ እንዲያስፈቱ በጫና ውስጥ ባለችበት ወቅት ነው። ጉብኝቱ በኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን ክልል የተፈጸመውን የድሮን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የሚመጣ ሲሆን፣ ኢራን በጥቃቱ ተሳትፎ እንደሌላት አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, dhimmoota nageenya naannichaa fi walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii irratti mari'achuuf gara Iraaq imaluuf qophaa'aniiru. Imalli kun kan ta'e, mootummaan Iraaq gareewwan hidhattoota Iran deggeraman hanga dhuma ji'a Fulbaanaatti akka hidhannoo hiikkatan dhiibbaa irra jirtu keessatti. Imalli kun kan dhufu erga naannoo Kurdistani Iraaqitti haleellaan xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) raawwatamee booda yoo ta'u, Iran haleellaa kana keessatti hirmaannaa akka hin qabne ibsiteetti.

title: Deaths mount, trauma sets in as Russia ramps up missile attacks on Ukraine
english: Russia has intensified its missile and drone strikes on Ukraine, marking July as the deadliest month of the conflict since 2022. Due to a critical shortage of Western air defense systems, many civilians have been killed or injured in strikes on residential and public areas. These attacks are leaving families devastated and causing long-term psychological trauma for survivors who have lost loved ones and homes.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ የምታደርገውን የሚሳኤል እና ድሮን ጥቃት አጠናክራ በመቀጠሏ፣ ሐምሌ ወር ከ2022 ወዲህ እጅግ አሰቃቂ የሞት ቁጥር የተመዘገበበት ወር ሆኗል። የምዕራባውያን የአየር መከላከያ ሥርዓቶች እጥረት በመኖሩ፣ በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎች በመኖሪያ እና በሕዝብ ቦታዎች ላይ በሚደርሱ ጥቃቶች ሕይወታቸውን እያጡ እና እየቆሰሉ ነው። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ቤተሰቦችን ከማፈናቀላቸውም በላይ፣ የሚወዷቸውን ያጡ እና መኖሪያ ቤታቸው የወደመባቸው ሰዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እየፈጠሩ ነው።
oromo: Raashiyaan haleellaa ishee isa misaa'elaa fi dooniiwwan (drones) ukreen irratti dabaluun, ji'a Adooleessaa bara 2022 as ji'a namoonni hedduun itti du'an taasifteetti. Sirnoonni ittisa qilleensaa kan dhihaa gahaa ta'uu dhabuun, namoonni nagaan hedduun haleellaa bakka jireenyaa fi bakka uummataa irratti raawwatameen du'uu fi miidhamuu gadhiseera. Haleellaan kun maatiiwwan miidhuu qofa osoo hin taane, namoota jaallatamoo isaanii dhabanii fi mana isaanii dhaban irratti miidhaa sammuu (trauma) kan yeroo dheeraa fiduu irra jira.

title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement makes schools next battleground against Modi
english: The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), an Indian activist group that recently forced the resignation of the education minister, has launched a new campaign to audit the poor conditions of government-funded schools. During a local school inspection, a young activist named Abdul Hafeez was attacked by suspected political opponents, resulting in the death of his father. Despite this tragedy, the group remains committed to holding the government accountable for improving infrastructure, sanitation, and resources in public schools.
amharic: የህንድ 'ኮክሮች ጃናታ ፓርቲ' የተባለ የተቃውሞ ቡድን፣ የሀገሪቱን የመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች ሁኔታ ለመገምገም አዲስ ዘመቻ ጀምሯል። ቡድኑ ከዚህ ቀደም የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ እንዲለቁ በማድረግ ስኬት አስመዝግቦ ነበር። ሆኖም በአንድ ትምህርት ቤት ምርመራ ወቅት የተከሰተ ጥቃት የነቃ ተሟጋች አባት ህይወት እንዲያልፍ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ቢኖርም፣ ቡድኑ ለትምህርት ቤቶች የተሻለ መሰረተ ልማት እና አቅርቦት ለመጠየቅ የሚያደርገውን እንቅስቃሴ እንደማያቆም አስታውቋል።
oromo: gareen mormituu Hindii 'Cockroach Janata Party' jedhamu, haala manneen barnoota mootummaa fooyyessuuf duula haaraa jalqabeera. title: Asian Champions League draw: Holders Al-Ahli to face former winners Al Ain
english: The Asian Champions League Elite draw has paired the reigning champions, Al-Ahli, against former winners Al Ain in an expanded 32-team league phase. These teams will also compete against Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al-Nassr and various other regional clubs starting in September. The tournament will conclude with the final stages held in Saudi Arabia next spring.

Gareewwan kunneen tapha liigii miseensa 32 qabu kana keessatti garee Cristiano Ronaldo kan ta’e Al-Nassr fi gareewwan biroo waliin morkatu. Taphoonni kunneen Hagayya booda kan jalqaban yoo ta’u, xumura isaanii gara fuulduraatti biyya Sa’ud Arabiyaatti kan geggeeffamu ta’a.

title: Eight air strikes hit airbase in Syria’s Idlib
english: Eight air strikes recently targeted the Abu al-Duhur military base in Syria's Idlib province, causing significant damage to the runway. Syrian state media identified the Israeli military as the party responsible for the attack, though Israel has not provided a comment. This marks the first strike on the facility since the fall of the Assad regime, highlighting an ongoing campaign to limit Syrian military capabilities.

oromo: Humni qilleensaa Israa'el iddoo waraanaa Abu al-Duhur kan naannoo Idlib, Siiriyaa irratti qilleensaan haleellaa saddeet gaggeessiteera. Haleellaan kun bakka xiyyaarri buutu irratti miidhaa guddaa kan qaqqabsiise yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti humni waraanaa Israa'el waan jedhe tokko hin jiru. Kunis mootummaan Bashar al-Asaad erga kufee as iddoo sana irratti haleellaa raawwatame isa jalqabaa yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun dandeettii waraana Siiriyaa laaffisuuf kan karoorfame fakkaata.

title: Brazil’s president says Amazon oil is ‘passport to the future’
english: Brazilian President Lula da Silva has defended the exploration of oil deposits found off the Amazon coast, labeling the discovery as vital for the nation's progress. While environmental groups strongly oppose drilling in this sensitive region, the president argues that the project will bolster Brazil's economic independence and sovereignty. He views these resources as a key asset for the country's development in the coming years.
amharic: የብራዚሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉኢዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ በአማዞን የባህር ዳርቻ የተገኘውን የነዳጅ ሀብት ለሀገሪቱ የወደፊት ዕድገት ወሳኝ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ተሟጋቾች በስፍራው የሚደረገውን የነዳጅ ቁፋሮ በጽኑ ቢቃወሙም፣ ፕሬዚዳንቱ ፕሮጀክቱ የብራዚልን የኢኮኖሚ ነጻነት እንደሚያጠናክር ይከራከራሉ። ይህን የነዳጅ ክምችት የሀገሪቱን ብሔራዊ ጥቅም ለማስጠበቅ እንደ ትልቅ ዕድል እንደሚመለከቱት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin biyya Braazil Lula da Siilvaa, qabeenyi boba’aa qarqara laga Amaazoonitti argame, gara fuulduraatti biyyattii fayyaduu fi guddinaaf murteessaa ta’uu ibsaniiru. Gareewwan eegumsa naannoo qonnaan boba’aa kanaa mormaa jiranus, pirezedantichi hojiin kun guddina diinagdee fi bilisummaa biyyattii kan cimsamu ta’uu dubbatu. Innis, boba’aa kana guddina biyyattii ittiin ariifachiisuufi madda humnaa guddaa akka ta’e himaniiru.

title: Syrian man dies in custody after alleged abuse by security officers
english: A Syrian man has passed away while in police detention following claims that he was brutally beaten by security personnel. His family stated that they had cautioned officers about his haemophilia condition prior to the alleged abuse. In response to the outcry, the Syrian Interior Ministry has taken seven officers into custody to face an investigation regarding the incident.

oromo: Namni Soriyaa tokko yeroo to'annaa poolisii jiru keessatti reebicha irra ga'een du'uu isaa maatiin isaa ibsaniiru. Maatiin namichaa akka jedhanitti, dhukkuba dhiigni itti hin citte (haemophilia) qabaachuu isaa erga himanii booda poolisonni reebicha irratti raawwachuu isaanii dubbatu. Haala kanaan walqabatee, Ministeerri Dhimma Keessaa Soriyaa poolisoota torba to'annaa jala oolchuun qorannoo jalqabeera.

title: Meta lawsuits: Is social media facing a global legal reckoning?
english: Meta is facing a significant lawsuit in the United States brought by 29 states that accuse the company of creating addictive platforms that harm the mental health of children. The legal action challenges specific features like continuous scrolling and data collection practices, potentially costing the company over a trillion dollars in damages. Beyond financial penalties, the states are demanding major technical changes to Meta’s apps to better protect young users and ensure parental oversight.
amharic: ሜታ በአሜሪካ የ29 ግዛቶች ጥምረት የቀረበበት ከፍተኛ ክስ እየገጠመው ሲሆን፣ ኩባንያው የህፃናትን የአእምሮ ጤና የሚጎዱ ሱስ አስያዥ መድረኮችን ገንብቷል በሚል ይወቀሳል። የክሱ አቅራቢዎች በተለይ የማያቋርጥ የገጽ መግለጥ ባህሪን እና የግል መረጃ አያያዝን በመተቸት፣ ኩባንያው በአንድ ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የገንዘብ ቅጣት ሊጣልበት እንደሚችል ይናገራሉ። ከገንዘብ ቅጣቱ በተጨማሪ፣ የህግ ባለሙያዎች ሜታ ወጣቶችን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል የመተግበሪያዎቹን አሰራር እንዲቀይር እና የወላጆችን ቁጥጥር እንዲያጠናክር እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Meta dhaabbata isaa irratti himannaan guddaan biyyoota US 29 irraa dhiyaateen wal qabatee rakkoo keessa galeera. Himannaan kun Meta fiilmoota fi appilikeeshinoota dargaggootaaf midhaa sammuu geessisaniifi barattoota irratti qabachuu fi qabiyyee isaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatuudha. Himannaan kun dhaabbaticharraa qarshii tiriliyoona tokkoo ol akka gaafatamuuf kan taasisu ta'uu fi dhaabbatichi akkaataa itti fayyadama appilikeeshinoota isaa jijjiiruu qaba jedhamee amanama. Kana malees, hirmaattonni himannichaa Meta sirna to'annoo warraaf mijataa ta'e akka diriirsuu fi dhimmoota nageenya dargaggootaa irratti jijjiirama bu'uuraa akka fidu gaafataniiru.

title: Infantino’s FIFA World Cup fallout: Lamour exits after criticism of plan
english: FIFA Chief Operating Officer Kevin Lamour has left the organization following his vocal opposition to Gianni Infantino’s controversial plan to sell commercial stakes in the World Cup. Lamour had publicly accused the FIFA president of prioritizing personal interests over the organization's mission, contributing to the plan's eventual withdrawal. This internal conflict has weakened Infantino's standing as he faces growing pressure and a more uncertain path toward his reelection next year.

oromo: Hogganaan olaanaan hoji raawwachiiftuu FIFA Keveen Laamoor, yaada gabaa waancaa addunyaa irratti qooda gurguruuf jiyaani Iinfaantiinoo dhiyeesse mormuusaatiin dhaabbatichaa gadhiiseera. Laamoor piirezidaantichi FIFA akka dhaabbataatti osoo hin taane fedhii dhuunfaa isaatiif akka hojjechaa jiru himatee ture; kunis yaadrimee kana akka dhaabbatu godheera. Falmiin keessaa kun, Iinfaantiinoon fuuldura isaatti filannoo marsaa ittaanuuf qabu irratti shakkiifi mormii cimaa akka mudatu isa taasiseera.

title: Videos show deadly school shooting in Philippines
english: A ninth-grade student carried out a fatal shooting at a high school in Zamboanga, Philippines. The attack resulted in the deaths of the shooter and one classmate, while two other students sustained injuries. Reports suggest that the violence was broadcast live on the internet by the perpetrator.

oromo: Filippinsii keessatti mana barnoota sadarkaa lammaffaa Zamboangatti barataan kutaa saglaffaa tokko dhukaasa baneen lubbuun darbeera. title: Pakistan top court orders Imran Khan’s hospital transfer amid access battle
english: Pakistan's Supreme Court has ordered former Prime Minister Imran Khan to be moved from prison to a hospital for medical treatment following concerns about his blood pressure and heart health. The court-mandated stay allows him to be treated by his own doctors and visit with his family for at least a month. Khan has been incarcerated since 2023 on various charges, which he and his supporters maintain are politically driven.

oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Paakistaanitti dura ta'aa mootummaa duraanii Imraan Khaan dhibee dhiibbaa dhiigaa fi onnee isaanii irratti xiyyeeffachuun, manni hidhaa gadhiissee gara hospitaalaatti akka geessaman ajajee jira. Murtii kanaan, Khaan hospitaala keessatti baatii tokkoof oolanii, ogeeyyii fayyaa isaan filataniin akka yaalaman akkasumas maatii isaanii wajjin akka wal argan hayyamameef jira. Khaan bara 2023 irraa eegalee himannaa garaa garaatiin hidhaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, isaanis ta'e deggertoonni isaanii himannaan kun duula siyaasaa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Cincinnati Open: Williams sisters fall in doubles while Zverev advances
english: In the Cincinnati Open, Alexander Zverev secured a hard-fought victory against Terrance Atmane to reach the fourth round. Meanwhile, sisters Serena and Venus Williams played their first doubles match together in four years but were ultimately defeated in a tie-break. Other players like Alex de Minaur also progressed to the next round despite difficult weather conditions caused by rain.
amharic: በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር ላይ አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭ ተጋጣሚውን ተርንስ አትማንን በማሸነፍ ወደ አራተኛው ዙር አልፏል። በሌላ በኩል ሴሬና እና ቪነስ ዊሊያምስ ለአራት ዓመታት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በአንድ ላይ በድርብ ውድድር ቢሳተፉም በመጨረሻ ተሸንፈዋል። እንዲሁም አሌክስ ደ ሚናር በተደጋጋሚ ዝናብ እና ሌሎች ፈታኝ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩም ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር ማለፍ ችሏል።
oromo: Dorgommii Cincinnati Open irratti, Aleksandar Zverev morkataa isaa Terrance Atmane injifachuun gara sadarkaa afuraffaatti darbeera. Gamtaan obboleewwan Serina fi Vinas Wiliyaams waggaa afur booda walta'anii taphatanis, injifannoo argachuu osoo hin danda'in hafaniiru. Taphattoonni biroo kanneen akka Aleks de Minaar immoo, rakkoo roobaan uumame hunda dandamatanii gara sadarkaa itti aanutti darbuu danda'aniiru.

title: Hormuz Strait to remain closed until US meets interim deal conditions, says Iran
english: Iran has announced that the Strait of Hormuz will stay blocked until the United States complies with the terms of their interim agreement. Iranian negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that the U.S. must remove marine blockades and economic sanctions while also releasing frozen Iranian funds. Tehran intends to keep this vital shipping route closed until these specific demands are addressed.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በእሷ መካከል የተደረሰውን ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት እስክታከብር ድረስ ዝግ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቃለች። የኢራን ዋና ተደራዳሪ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ እንደገለጹት አሜሪካ ማዕቀቦችን ማንሳት፣ የባህር ላይ እገዳዎችን ማቆም እና የታገዱ የኢራን ንብረቶችን መልቀቅ አለባት። እነዚህ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እስኪሟሉ ድረስ ወሳኙ የባህር መስመር ዝግ እንደሚሆን ተነግሯል።
oromo: Iraan daandiin galaana Hormuz hamma yeroo Ameerikaan walii galtee yerootii isaanii waliin mallatteessite kabajutti cufaa ta'ee akka turu beeksisteetti. Mari'achiisaan olaanaan Iraan Mohammad Baager Gaalibaaf akka ibsanitti, Ameerikaan uggura diinagdee fi kan galaana irraa kaasuu akkasumas qabeenya Iraan kan kanaan dura uggurame gadhiisuu qabdi. Iraan gaaffiiwwan kunneen hamma deebii argatutti daandiin kun cufaa ta'ee akka turu murteessiteetti.

title: Trump lashes out at CNN reporter over South Korea question
english: Donald Trump reacted angrily to a CNN reporter during a media event after being questioned about potential military drill reductions in South Korea. The former president dismissed the journalist, labeling them as a fake reporter rather than answering the inquiry about North Korea. This interaction highlights the ongoing tensions between Trump and certain news organizations.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር በሚደረጉ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶች ዙሪያ ጥያቄ ያቀረበላቸውን የሲኤንኤን ጋዜጠኛ በቁጣ አጣጥለዋል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ለጋዜጠኛው የሐሰት ዘጋቢ ናቸው በማለት ጥያቄውን ከመመለስ ተቆጥበዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በፕሬዝዳንቱ እና በአንዳንድ የዜና አውታሮች መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Donald Traamp gaaffii gaazexeessaan CNN tokko shaakala waraanaa Koriyaa Kibbaa wajjin walqabatee dhiyeesseef dheekkamsaan deebisaniiru. Dura ta'aan kun gaazexeessicha 'gaazexeessaa sobaa' jechuun waamuun, gaaffii wa'ee Koriyaa Kaabaa dhiyeeffamef deebii kennuu didaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun hariiroo cimaa Traampii fi dhaabbilee miidiyaa tokko tokko gidduu jiru agarsiisa.

title: Syrian court sentences Wassim al-Assad to death
english: A Syrian court has handed a death sentence to Wassim al-Assad, a cousin of former leader Bashar al-Assad. He was convicted of serious crimes committed during the civil war, such as intentional murder and torture. This legal action follows recent similar death sentences issued against other top members of the former regime, including Bashar al-Assad himself.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞው መሪ ባሻር አል-አሳድ የአጎት ልጅ የሆኑትን ዋሲም አል-አሳድን በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወስኗል። ዋሲም አል-አሳድ በአገሪቱ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት በፈጸሟቸው እንደ ግድያ እና ስቃይ ባሉ ከባድ ወንጀሎች ጥፋተኛ ተብለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከጥቂት ቀናት በፊት በባሻር አል-አሳድ እና በሌሎች የቀድሞው መንግስት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ላይ ከተላለፈው ተመሳሳይ የሞት ቅጣት ጋር ተያያዥነት ያለው ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Siriyaatti, wasiila hogganaa duraanii Bashar Al-Asaad kan ta'an Wassim Al-Asaad irratti adabbii du'aa murteesse. Wassim Al-Asaad waraana cimaa biyyattii keessatti yakka ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwataniin himatamuun irratti mirkanaa'eera. Murteen kun, guyyoota muraasa dura Bashar Al-Asaad dabalatee qondaalota sirnichaa biroo irratti adabbiin du'aa dabarsuu isaanii hordofee kan dhufe dha.

title: Chinese company unveils new ‘Superman’ humanoid robot
english: A Chinese startup named Unitree has introduced a new humanoid robot dubbed Superman. The robot is designed for impressive physical performance, featuring the ability to leap two meters high. Furthermore, the company claims it can outrun the fastest human over a 100-meter distance.
amharic: ዩኒትሪ የተሰኘ የቻይና ኩባንያ 'ሱፐርማን' የተሰኘ አዲስ የሰው መልክ ያለው ሮቦት ይፋ አድርጓል። ሮቦቱ ሁለት ሜትር ከፍታ ላይ መዝለል የሚችል ሲሆን፤ የኩባንያው መረጃ እንደሚያመለክተው ደግሞ በ100 ሜትር ሩጫ ከማንኛውም ሰው በበለጠ ፍጥነት መሮጥ ይችላል።
oromo: Qoqqooddoota Chaayinaa kan ta'an Unitree jedhaman, 'Superman' kan jedhamu fi bifa namaa fakkaatu qabuufi konkolaataa elektirooniksii haaraa hojjetan. Roobootti kun meetira lama ol utaaluu kan danda'u yoo ta'u, dorgommii fiigicha meetira dhibba keessatti nama kamiyyuu caalaa saffisaan fiiguu akka danda'u dhaabbatichi ibseera.

title: What to watch in Tuesday’s Florida primary elections
english: Florida voters are participating in primary elections this Tuesday, which serve as the first test for newly redrawn congressional districts designed to favor Republican candidates. A major focus is the crowded Republican race for governor, where Congressman Byron Donalds, backed by Donald Trump, is currently the frontrunner. These elections highlight Florida's significant shift toward the Republican party over the last decade, posing a major challenge for Democrats attempting to regain political influence in the state.
amharic: የፍሎሪዳ መራጮች ማክሰኞ በሚካሄደው የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫ ላይ ድምፃቸውን እየሰጡ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ምርጫ ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ተወዳዳሪዎች እንዲያደላ ተደርጎ የተቀየሰውን አዲስ የምርጫ ክልል ካርታ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሚፈትሽ ይሆናል። ትኩረቱ በዋናነት በሪፐብሊካን የገዥነት እጩዎች መካከል ባለው ውድድር ላይ ያተኮረ ሲሆን፣ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ድጋፍ የሚያገኙት ባይሮን ዶናልድስ ግንባር ቀደም ተወዳዳሪ ሆነው ቀርበዋል። ይህ ምርጫ ላለፉት አስርት ዓመታት ፍሎሪዳ ወደ ቀኝ ዘንበል ማለቷን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ለዴሞክራቶች በግዛቲቱ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ መልሰው ለማግኘት ፈታኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Filattoonni Floridaa Kibxata har'a filannoo jalqabaa irratti hirmaachaa jiru; kunis kaartaa daangaa filannoo haaraa kanneen bakka bu'oota Rippabliikaaniif mijaatu ta'e qorachuuf carraa jalqabaati. Xiyyeeffannoon guddaan dorgommii guddaa gama bulchiinsa mootummaa naannichaa (governor) irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, kanaanis miseensi Kongireesii Bayron Doonaalds kan deggarsa Doonaald Traamp argatan dursee jira. Filannoon kun Floridaan waggoota kudhan darban keessa gara siyaasa mirgaatti gombisamuu ishee agarsiisa; kunis warra Dimookiraataaf dhiibbaa siyaasaa naannichaa deeffachuuf waan ulfaataa ta'eera.

title: Top Russian economist ousted after warning of growing costs of Ukraine war
english: Andrey Klepach, the chief economist at Russia's state-run bank VEB, has been dismissed after his critical remarks about the economic impact of the war in Ukraine became public. In a speech, he argued that Russia is falling behind technologically and economically, warning that the ongoing conflict is creating a long-term social and fiscal crisis. This rare critique from a senior government official highlights the growing internal strain caused by the war of attrition.
amharic: የሩሲያ የልማት ባንክ ዋና ኢኮኖሚስት የነበሩት አንድሬ ክሌፓች፣ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ምክንያት የሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ እየተዳከመ መሆኑን በይፋ በመተቸታቸው ከኃላፊነታቸው ተነስተዋል። ክሌፓች በንግግራቸው ሩሲያ በቴክኖሎጂ እና በኢኮኖሚ ከሌሎች አገራት ወደ ኋላ እየቀረች እንደሆነና ጦርነቱ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ከባድ ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስ እንደሚፈጥር አስጠንቅቀው ነበር። ይህ የመንግስት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን የሰጡት ትችት ጦርነቱ በሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ እየፈጠረ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጫና ያሳያል።
oromo: Gorsaan diinagdee olaanaa baankii mootummaa Raashiyaa (VEB) kan ta'an Andrey Klepach, waraanni Yukreenii diinagdee biyyattii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jiraachuusaanii dubbachuusaanii hordofee hojiirraa ari'amaniiru. Klepach, Raashiyaan guddina teknooloojii fi diinagdeen biyyoota kaan irraa duubatti hafaa akka jirtu fi waraanni kun rakkoo hawaasummaa fi dinagdee cimaa fiduu danda'a jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru. Adeemsi kun, qeeqni akkanaa hoggansa olaanaa mootummaa keessaa dhufuunsaa miidhaa waraanni kun biyyattii irratti geessisaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
english: China recently held a private funeral for former Premier Zhu Rongji, a key economic reformer who passed away at 97. While the government honored him as a loyal party member, authorities are actively censoring public expressions of grief and online tributes. This suppression reflects the state's fear that nostalgia for Zhu's era could transform into protests against the current administration.
amharic: ቻይና በቅርቡ በ97 አመታቸው ያረፉትን የቀድሞ የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዡ ሮንግጂን የቀብር ስነስርዓት በድብቅ አካሂዳለች። መንግስት የሟቹን ታማኝነት ቢገልጽም፣ የህዝብ ሀዘን መግለጫዎችን እና በኢንተርኔት የሚወጡ አድናቆቶችን በጽኑ እየተቆጣጠረ ይገኛል። ይህም የሟቹን ዘመን መናፈቅ በወቅታዊው መንግስት ላይ ወደ ተቃውሞ ሊቀየር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት እንዳላቸው ያሳያል።
oromo: Chaayinaan yeroo ammaa kana awwaalcha muummicha ministeeraa durii Zhu Rongjii, namoota biyyattii guddina dinagdee irratti gahee guddaa qaban keessaa tokko ta'anii fi umurii 97tti du'an raawwatteetti. Mootummaan akka miseensa dhaabaa amanamuutti isaan kabajus, miira gadduu fi yaada weebsaayitii irratti kennamu irratti hammaa'ina cimaa gochaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun yaadannoon bara isaanii kun gara mormii mootummaa ammaa irratti kan geessu ta'uu isaa mootummaan akka sodaatu agarsiisa.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's current political climate in Tigray reflects historical patterns that previously led to Eritrea's independence. The government's National Dialogue is being criticized for excluding key armed and political factions, leading many to view it as an ineffective process rather than a genuine effort for peace. By failing to include Tigray in national elections or policy discussions, the state risks further alienating the region and repeating the governance failures of the past.

title: Israel’s siege on Gaza is creating a breast cancer crisis
english: The ongoing siege and conflict in Gaza have severely disrupted the healthcare system, leaving women with breast cancer unable to access timely diagnosis and essential treatment. Due to a critical shortage of medical equipment, such as mammography machines, and a lack of specialized care, patients are facing delayed interventions and worsening health outcomes. Health experts warn that this collapse in medical services is creating a dire crisis for thousands of women battling the disease.

title: Canada battles the clock, politics in scramble to avert Trump’s tariffs
english: The Canadian government is urgently negotiating with the United States to prevent the implementation of 50-percent tariffs on various Canadian exports. President Trump plans to apply these duties to goods like electronics, machinery, and dairy products, claiming that Canada treats American products unfairly. If a deal is not reached quickly, these significant taxes will threaten numerous Canadian businesses by making their products too expensive for the American market.

oromo: Mootummaan Kaanaadaa gatii meeshaalee gara Ameerikaa ergiturraa dhibbeentaa 50 ol ka'uuf karoorfame ittisuuf Ameerikaa waliin marii ariifachiisaa gochaa jira. title: Russia says more than 600 drones targeted Moscow region
english: Russian authorities reported a massive drone assault involving over 600 aircraft targeting the Moscow region, marking one of the largest attacks since the conflict began. While many drones were intercepted, the debris caused injuries to three people and damaged residential homes and a logistics warehouse. This escalation in long-distance strikes comes as both Russia and Ukraine increase their use of drone warfare against infrastructure and civilian targets.
amharic: የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት ከ600 በላይ ድሮኖች የሞስኮን ክልል ኢላማ ያደረጉበት መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቀዋል። አብዛኞቹ ድሮኖች በሩሲያ የአየር መከላከያ ቢመቱም፣ የወደቁት የድሮን ስብርባሪዎች ሶስት ሰዎችን በማቁሰል የመኖሪያ ቤቶችንና የሎጂስቲክስ መጋዘኖችን አውድመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ሁለቱም ሀገራት በጦርነቱ ውስጥ የረጅም ርቀት የድሮን ጥቃቶችን በእጅጉ በመጨመራቸው የተፈጠረ ነው፡፡
oromo: Hoggantoonni Raashiya akka ibsanitti, magaalota naannoo Moskow irratti xiyyara malee nam-deeman (drones) 600 ol fayyadamuun haleellaa guddaan raawwatameera. Xiyyaroonni kun hedduun isaanii ittisa qilleensaan kan kuffifaman ta'us, haphurriin isaanii namoota sadii miidhuu fi manneen jireenyaa akkasumas bakka kuusaa meeshaalee mancaasera. title: Vessel hit by ‘unknown projectile’ in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
english: A commercial ship traveling through the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unidentified projectile, causing damage to its engine room and one crew member to suffer injuries. The Omani coastguard is currently assisting the crew, and authorities have launched an investigation into the attack. This incident occurred amidst heightened regional tensions and a recent lapse in agreements aimed at keeping the vital waterway open.

Eegdonni qarqara galaana Omaan gargaarsa kennuuf iddoo sana qaqqabaniiru akkasumas qaamoleen dhimmi ilaalu qorannoo jalqabaniiru. title: Can China’s new Arctic Sea route to Europe replace Middle East chokepoints?
english: China has launched a new 'Ice Silk Road' shipping route through the Arctic Ocean to connect Asia and Europe more efficiently. This path significantly reduces travel time compared to traditional routes through the Suez Canal or around Africa, which are currently facing disruptions due to regional conflicts. While this offers a faster alternative for time-sensitive goods, analysts warn that it may create new geopolitical tensions, particularly with the United States.
amharic: ቻይና በሰሜን ዋልታ በኩል የሚያልፍ አዲስ የባህር ንግድ መስመር የሆነውን 'አይስ ሲልክ ሮድ' ይፋ አድርጋለች። ይህ መስመር በአሁኑ ወቅት በግጭቶች ሳቢያ ከተስተጓጎሉት እንደ ቀይ ባህር ካሉ ባህላዊ የመርከብ መስመሮች በበለጠ ፍጥነት እስያን እና አውሮፓን ያገናኛል። ይህ አዲስ የንግድ መስመር ፈጣን አገልግሎት ቢሰጥም፣ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በተለይም ከአሜሪካ ጋር የፖለቲካ ውጥረትን ሊቀሰቅስ እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Chaayinaan karaa galaana Arktik fayyadamuun daandiin daldalaa haaraan 'Ice Silk Road' jedhamu kan inni jalqabe ta'uun beekameera. Daandiin kun meeshaalee saffisaan gahuu qabanif filannoo gaarii ta'us, dorgommii geopolitikii keessattuu kan Chaayinaafi Ameerikaa gidduu jiru daran hammaachisuu akka danda'u xiinxaltoonni ni ibsu.

title: Iran's Ghalibaf heads to Iraq on Wednesday for cooperation talks
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf is traveling to Iraq on Wednesday to meet with top government officials. The visit aims to improve strategic relations between the two nations by focusing on economic partnerships, regional security, and border cooperation. Both sides will also review the progress of existing agreements to strengthen their bilateral ties.
